name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Composable primary navigation with provider state, height modes, docked floating or inset variants, icon or offcanvas collapse, configurable seam edgeCollapse and edgeBorder with directional dual-tone cursor, collapsible groups with chevron toggles, List Item menu rows, kit ScrollArea content, menu hierarchy, and SidebarSeparator rules between sections.

api.description: Composable primary navigation layout. SidebarProvider owns open state, height, mobile overlay, keyboard toggle, and seam edge settings. Sidebar reserves a gap and paints a docked, floating, or inset panel. Expand and collapse use --df-sidebar-motion-* tokens for shell travel and content fades. On desktop, edgeCollapse enables double-click on the content-facing seam to collapse or expand, with a directional dual-tone cursor (active arrow toward the available action). edgeBorder controls the seam hover accent. SidebarTrigger and the mod+b shortcut remain the primary controls. SidebarContent owns the kit ScrollArea. Compose List Item inside SidebarMenuItem for rows. Prefer Tool Rail for icon mode switching and Dock Panel for inspectors.

groups.title: SidebarProvider
groups.description: Layout wrapper and context host. Wrap Sidebar and SidebarInset. Use layout frame inside a sized host.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial expanded state when uncontrolled.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled expanded state on desktop.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when desktop open state changes.

props.name: layout
props.description: app uses fixed viewport chrome. frame uses absolute positioning inside a sized host.

props.name: fillHeight
props.description: Stretch to the viewport (app) or host (frame). Ignored when height is set.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height. Prefer a kit length token. Sets --df-sidebar-height. For host frames, prefer fillHeight and size the host instead.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default appearance for nested Sidebar.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Default collapse mode for nested Sidebar.

props.name: edgeCollapse
props.description: Default for nested Sidebar. When true on desktop, double-click the content-facing seam to toggle open state. Ignored when collapsible is none, on mobile, and when layout is frame with offcanvas collapsed (width 0 clips the seam). Hover shows a dual-tone left/right cursor from --df-sidebar-edge-cursor-emphasize-left/right; the darker arrow points toward the available action.

props.name: edgeBorder
props.description: Default for nested Sidebar. When true with edgeCollapse, the seam shows a hover accent using --df-sidebar-border. Set false to keep the hit target and cursor without the accent line.

props.name: side
props.description: Default edge for nested Sidebar.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for toggles and the mobile panel.

props.name: keyboardShortcut
props.description: When true, mod+b toggles the sidebar.

props.name: width
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-width.

props.name: iconWidth
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-width-icon.

props.name: mobileWidth
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-width-mobile.

props.name: padding
props.description: CSS length applied to both panel padding axes (--df-sidebar-padding-block and --df-sidebar-padding-inline).

props.name: paddingBlock
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-padding-block on the panel.

props.name: paddingInline
props.description: Overrides --df-sidebar-padding-inline on the panel.

props.name: radius
props.description: Panel corner radius. Sets --df-sidebar-radius and --df-sidebar-radius-floating.

props.name: sectionRadius
props.description: Default radius for header, footer, and groups. Sets --df-sidebar-section-radius. Default 0.

props.name: itemRadius
props.description: Radius for menu buttons and group labels. Sets --df-sidebar-item-radius.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap inside header and footer stacks. Sets --df-sidebar-gap.

props.name: groupGap
props.description: Default gap inside SidebarGroup between the label, optional separators, and content. Sets --df-sidebar-group-gap. Override per group with SidebarGroup gap.

props.name: groupPadding
props.description: Default padding on all SidebarGroup axes. Override per group with SidebarGroup padding props.

props.name: groupPaddingBlock
props.description: Default SidebarGroup block padding (top and bottom in horizontal writing modes).

props.name: groupPaddingInline
props.description: Default SidebarGroup inline padding (start and end).

props.name: groupPaddingBlockStart
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-block-start. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-start.

props.name: groupPaddingBlockEnd
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-block-end. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-end.

props.name: groupPaddingInlineStart
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-inline-start. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-start.

props.name: groupPaddingInlineEnd
props.description: Default SidebarGroup padding-inline-end. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-end.

props.name: children
props.description: Typically Sidebar and SidebarInset.

groups.title: Sidebar
groups.description: Panel shell with uniform padding and radius. Compose sticky SidebarHeader, scrollable SidebarContent, and sticky SidebarFooter as children. On desktop when collapsible and edgeCollapse, double-click the content-facing seam (right of a left sidebar, left of a right sidebar) to toggle open state. The seam hit target is owned by the sidebar container, follows Sidebar data-side and variant inset, and sits outside menu chrome. Hover uses theme tokens --df-sidebar-edge-cursor-emphasize-left/right; the darker arrow marks the available direction. Unavailable on mobile, when collapsible is none, when edgeCollapse is false, and when layout is frame with offcanvas collapsed. On mobile, children render in an overlay panel.

props.name: side
props.description: Overrides the provider side.

props.name: variant
props.description: docked is flush with an inner-edge border. floating and inset use --df-sidebar-floating-inset for outer chrome. Panel radius uses --df-sidebar-radius-floating unless radius is set on the provider.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: offcanvas slides away. icon collapses to icon width. none stays expanded and omits the edge double-click target.

props.name: edgeCollapse
props.description: Overrides the provider edgeCollapse. When true on desktop, enables the seam hit target, directional cursor, and double-click toggle.

props.name: edgeBorder
props.description: Overrides the provider edgeBorder. When true with edgeCollapse, shows the seam hover accent (--df-sidebar-border).

props.name: children
props.description: Header, Content, Footer, Group, and Menu parts.

groups.title: SidebarInset
groups.description: Main workspace region beside the sidebar peer.

props.name: children
props.description: Page or tool content.

groups.title: SidebarTrigger
groups.description: Ghost icon button that calls toggleSidebar from context. Primary accessible control for collapse and expand. The content-facing panel edge double-click is a pointer convenience only.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional custom icon. Defaults to PanelLeft.

groups.title: SidebarHeader
groups.description: Sticky top region. Stays pinned while SidebarContent scrolls. No section padding; the panel owns padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius (0).

props.name: children
props.description: Brand row, SidebarTrigger, SidebarInput.

groups.title: SidebarContent
groups.description: Scrollable middle region between sticky header and footer. Wraps children in the kit ScrollArea. Place SidebarGroup parts here. Do not nest another ScrollArea inside.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: ScrollArea appearance. thumb is the wider overlay bar. edge is the thin flush accent.

props.name: thumbShape
props.description: ScrollArea thumb corner shape.

props.name: orientation
props.description: ScrollArea axes.

props.name: side
props.description: ScrollArea scrollbar edge.

props.name: visibility
props.description: ScrollArea thumb visibility. Default always so overflowing nav shows the kit thumb.

props.name: space
props.description: ScrollArea track inset. Defaults follow ScrollArea: auto for thumb, none for edge.

props.name: width
props.description: ScrollArea scrollbar thickness in pixels.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes on the ScrollArea viewport.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarGroup and SidebarSeparator parts. Place separators between groups or at the end of the scroll region.

groups.title: SidebarFooter
groups.description: Sticky bottom region. Stays pinned while SidebarContent scrolls. No section padding; the panel owns padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius (0).

props.name: children
props.description: Menu rows, SidebarSeparator, or custom chrome. Place a separator above footer menus when you want a bottom rule.

groups.title: SidebarInput
groups.description: Composes SearchInput for the sidebar header. Default pill variant. Hidden in icon collapse.

props.name: size
props.description: SearchInput size.

props.name: variant
props.description: SearchInput shape. Pill is the sidebar default.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show the clear control when the field has a value.

groups.title: SidebarSeparator
groups.description: Composes the kit Separator. Keeps data-df="separator" and applies df-sidebar-separator for sidebar chrome. Typical placements are between groups and above footer chrome. You can also place one after a SidebarGroupLabel when a rule under the title is needed.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the rule. Horizontal is the sidebar default.

props.name: decorative
props.description: When true, treated as presentational for assistive tech.

props.name: color
props.description: Rule color. Prefer tokens such as var(--df-sidebar-border). Sets --df-sidebar-separator.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the Separator root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the Separator root.

groups.title: SidebarGroup
groups.description: Nav section with optional label and content. Opt in with collapsible for a chevron that expands and collapses the content with a height animation. The panel owns outer padding. Use gap for space between the label and menu rows. Use padding props for per-group inset on any side.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Show a chevron on SidebarGroupLabel that toggles SidebarGroupContent. Default false keeps existing groups unchanged. Set true for hide and show.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state when collapsible.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state when collapsible.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open changes while collapsible.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for this section. Defaults to --df-sidebar-section-radius (0).

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the group label, optional separators, and SidebarGroupContent. Prefer spacing tokens such as calc(1 * var(--spacing-unit)). Sets --df-sidebar-group-gap on this group.

props.name: padding
props.description: Sets all four group padding axes to the same length.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.description: Sets group padding-block-start and padding-block-end.

props.name: paddingInline
props.description: Sets group padding-inline-start and padding-inline-end.

props.name: paddingBlockStart
props.description: Top padding in horizontal writing modes. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-start.

props.name: paddingBlockEnd
props.description: Bottom padding in horizontal writing modes. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-end.

props.name: paddingInlineStart
props.description: Inline-start padding. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-start.

props.name: paddingInlineEnd
props.description: Inline-end padding. Sets --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-end.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarGroupContent, and optional SidebarSeparator. A separator after the label is supported when a rule under the title is needed.

groups.title: SidebarGroupLabel
groups.description: Section title composed from Label with as="div". When the parent SidebarGroup is collapsible, appends a chevron toggle in the trailing slot. Hidden from assistive tech when the sidebar is icon-collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: Group title text.

props.name: leading
props.description: Slot before the title text. Pass an icon or custom node.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Optional trailing meta before the collapsible chevron. The chevron is owned by SidebarGroup when collapsible.

props.name: color
props.description: Title color. Sets --df-label-color. Defaults to --df-sidebar-group-label-fg.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Title font family. Sets --df-label-font.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Title font size. Sets --df-label-size.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Title font weight. Sets --df-label-weight.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge the layout class and collapse aria-hidden onto a single child element. Skips the automatic collapsible chevron.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the root.

groups.title: SidebarGroupAction
groups.description: Trailing icon button chrome for SidebarGroupLabel. Collapsible groups render a chevron with this control automatically. Use manually only for custom trailing actions. Hidden when the sidebar is icon-collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually a single icon.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto a single child element.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the control.

groups.title: SidebarGroupContent
groups.description: Group body. When the parent SidebarGroup is collapsible, the panel root (data-df="sidebar-group-content") animates open and closed with grid-template-rows using --df-sidebar-motion-duration and --df-sidebar-motion-ease, and the inner body uses data-df="sidebar-group-content-body". Closed panels set inert so focus cannot enter hidden rows.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep content mounted while closed so height can animate. Set false to unmount when closed.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually a SidebarMenu.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the content body.

groups.title: SidebarMenu
groups.description: Semantic ul for navigation rows.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarMenuItem rows.

groups.title: SidebarMenuItem
groups.description: List row wrapper (li). Place a List Item as the interactive child (as="button" or asChild link). Optional SidebarMenuBadge and SidebarMenuAction are siblings on this li.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shown when the sidebar is icon-collapsed on desktop. Wraps the first child (usually List Item).

props.name: children
props.description: List Item row, plus optional SidebarMenuBadge or SidebarMenuAction.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the li.

groups.title: SidebarMenuButton
groups.description: Deprecated compatibility shim over List Item. Prefer List Item inside SidebarMenuItem. Still exported so existing imports keep working.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Forwards to List Item asChild. Leading icon children are mapped into List Item leading so icon-collapse keeps the icon.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Maps to List Item selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Maps to List Item size. Sidebar chrome owns row height and may remap type for compact rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: outline adds a hairline ring via a shim class. Prefer List Item chrome props for new code.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Legacy collapsed tooltip. Prefer tooltip on SidebarMenuItem.

props.name: children
props.description: Leading icon plus label. Mapped to List Item leading and children.

groups.title: SidebarMenuAction
groups.description: Absolute action control on a menu item.

props.name: showOnHover
props.description: Hide until the item is hovered or focused.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto a single child element.

groups.title: SidebarMenuBadge
groups.description: Trailing count or status badge on a menu item.

props.name: children
props.description: Badge content.

groups.title: SidebarMenuSub
groups.description: Nested menu list with a leading guide border. Hidden in icon mode.

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarMenuSubItem rows with List Item children.

groups.title: SidebarMenuSubButton
groups.description: Deprecated compatibility shim over List Item for nested rows. Prefer List Item inside SidebarMenuSubItem.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Forwards to List Item asChild.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Maps to List Item selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Maps to List Item size. "sm" maps to List Item xs for compact sub rows. "md" maps to List Item md.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested row label or asChild link.

groups.title: useSidebar
groups.description: Context hook for open state, height mode, mobile state, toggleSidebar, edgeCollapse, edgeBorder, and layout flags. side, variant, and collapsible on the context are provider defaults; Sidebar prop overrides apply to the rendered shell and seam only.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-sidebar-width
props.description: Expanded desktop width.

props.name: --df-sidebar-width-icon
props.description: Icon-collapse width.

props.name: --df-sidebar-width-mobile
props.description: Mobile overlay width.

props.name: --df-sidebar-height
props.description: Fixed shell height when SidebarProvider height is set. Fill mode uses the viewport or host instead.

props.name: --df-sidebar-padding-block
props.description: Block padding on the sidebar panel. Override with padding or paddingBlock.

props.name: --df-sidebar-padding-inline
props.description: Inline padding on the sidebar panel. Override with padding or paddingInline.

props.name: --df-sidebar-padding
props.description: Shorthand of panel padding-block and padding-inline.

props.name: --df-sidebar-item-padding-inline
props.description: Inline padding inside menu buttons, group labels, and matching header rows.

props.name: --df-sidebar-gap
props.description: Gap inside header and footer stacks. Override with gap.

props.name: --df-sidebar-section-gap
props.description: Gap between sections in SidebarContent.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-gap
props.description: Gap inside SidebarGroup between the label, optional separators, and content. Override with SidebarProvider groupGap or SidebarGroup gap.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-start
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-block-start. Override with groupPaddingBlockStart or SidebarGroup paddingBlockStart.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-block-end
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-block-end. Override with groupPaddingBlockEnd or SidebarGroup paddingBlockEnd.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-start
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-inline-start. Override with groupPaddingInlineStart or SidebarGroup paddingInlineStart.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-padding-inline-end
props.description: SidebarGroup padding-inline-end. Override with groupPaddingInlineEnd or SidebarGroup paddingInlineEnd.

props.name: --df-sidebar-menu-gap
props.description: Gap between menu rows inside SidebarMenu.

props.name: --df-sidebar-floating-inset
props.description: Outer inset for floating and inset variants. Separate from panel padding.

props.name: --df-sidebar-bg
props.description: Panel background.

props.name: --df-sidebar-fg
props.description: Panel foreground.

props.name: --df-sidebar-border
props.description: Panel border and edge hover accent. Default source for --df-sidebar-separator.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-duration
props.description: Duration for expand and collapse width, gap, and shell travel.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-ease
props.description: Easing for expand and collapse shell travel.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-fade-duration
props.description: Duration for label, brand, and input fades during icon collapse.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-fade-ease
props.description: Easing for content fades during icon collapse.

props.name: --df-sidebar-motion-fade-delay-expand
props.description: Delay before content fades in when expanding from icon mode, so width leads the reveal.

props.name: --df-sidebar-edge-hit-width
props.description: Desktop hit width for the content-facing seam double-click toggle. Anchored on the panel seam outside menu chrome.

props.name: --df-sidebar-edge-cursor-emphasize-left
props.description: Dual-tone seam cursor when the available action is toward the left. Darker left arrow. Falls back to w-resize. Dark theme overrides the SVG tones.

props.name: --df-sidebar-edge-cursor-emphasize-right
props.description: Dual-tone seam cursor when the available action is toward the right. Darker right arrow. Falls back to e-resize. Dark theme overrides the SVG tones.

props.name: --df-sidebar-z-edge
props.description: Stacking for the content-facing seam hit target on the sidebar container.

props.name: --df-sidebar-separator
props.description: SidebarSeparator rule color. Override with color on SidebarSeparator.

props.name: --df-sidebar-accent
props.description: Hover and active fill.

props.name: --df-sidebar-menu-button-height-md
props.description: Default menu row height.

props.name: --df-sidebar-radius
props.description: Docked panel radius. Override with radius.

props.name: --df-sidebar-radius-floating
props.description: Floating and inset panel radius. Override with radius.

props.name: --df-sidebar-section-radius
props.description: Default radius for header, footer, and groups. Override with sectionRadius or a section radius prop.

props.name: --df-sidebar-item-radius
props.description: Radius for menu buttons and group labels. Override with itemRadius.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-label-fg
props.description: Default SidebarGroupLabel title color. Maps to --df-label-color on the group label.

props.name: --df-demo-stage-height
props.description: Shared height for docs workspace stage frames.

props.name: --df-sidebar-mobile-scrim
props.description: Mobile overlay scrim behind the panel.
